title: EChest Plus
description: Upgrade your server's Ender Chests with fully persistent, multi-page 54-slot vaults. Features include permission-based sizing.
body:
**EChest+ | The Ultimate Ender Chest Upgrade**
Upgrade your server's storage capabilities with EChest+! This plugin completely overhauls the vanilla Minecraft Ender Chest system, replacing the standard 27-slot inventory with a massive, fully customizable, multi-page vault.

Whether you run a Survival, Factions, or Skyblock server, EChest+ provides a seamless, lag-free storage solution that rewards your players and gives admins ultimate control.



**🌟 Core Features**
Massive Multi-Page Vaults: Right-clicking any physical Ender Chest opens a custom 54-slot menu instead of the tiny vanilla UI.

Optimized Layout: Each page contains 52 usable storage slots. The bottom-left (◄) and bottom-right (►) slots are dedicated to page navigation, making it incredibly intuitive for players to use.

Permission-Based Scaling: Reward your VIPs or higher ranks! Use the permission echestplus.pages.<n> to grant specific page counts. For example, granting echestplus.pages.10 gives a player 10 pages, totaling 520 safe item slots. Players without a specific node will default to the page count defined in the config.yml (default is 3).

Rock-Solid Data Persistence: Player data is strictly bound and securely saved to disk. Vaults automatically save upon closing the menu, flipping pages, or during server shutdowns, ensuring no items are ever lost or duped.



**💻 Commands & Permissions**
EChest+ includes quality-of-life commands so players don't even need to place a block to access their gear, alongside powerful moderation tools.

/echest — Opens the player's EChest vault from anywhere.

/echest <page> — Instantly jumps to a specific page number.

/echest <player> — Allows administrators to secretly inspect, manage, or edit any player's vault. This works even if the target player is offline! (Requires permission: echestplus.admin)



**⚙️ Easy Setup**
Simply drop the .jar into your plugins folder and restart your server. EChest+ is highly optimized, lightweight, and works perfectly right out of the box!
